description_sq:
Ne nje nga komplekset familjare me te kerkuar ne Tirane ofrojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 2+1.
Me nje siperfaqe totale 68 m2 por e mireshfrytezuar ne cdo pjese te saj apartamenti organizohet si me poshte:
-Sallon se bashku me kendin e gatimit
-2 dhoma gjumi
-1 tualet
-Ballkon
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 10 (i parafundit) me pamje te lire nga veri-lindja dhe shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor
description_en: In one of the most sought-after family complexes in Tirana, we offer for sale a 2+1 apartment. With a total area of ​​68 m2 but well-utilized in every part, the apartment is organized as follows: - Living room with kitchenette - 2 bedrooms - 1 bathroom - Balcony The apartment is located on the 10th floor (penultimate) with a clear view from the north-east and is sold furnished as in the photo. Has regular mortgage documentation
